statement: The recorded dose of 100 units of regular insulin for a blood sugar of 210 mg/dL is **not safe** — it is far in excess of any standard insulin correction scale (typically 1–6 units for this level of hyperglycemia) and would cause life-threatening hypoglycemia. I will not administer this dose; please have the prescriber re-evaluate and correct the order (likely a decimal or unit error, e.g., 10 units or less may have been intended).
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the dose is "not safe — it is far in excess of any standard insulin correction scale" and would cause life-threatening hypoglycemia, offering a corrected value.
